verdict.rationale: mParticle's Data Privacy Controls docs describe consent state (GDPR and CCPA opt-out) that can be attached to forwarding rules to block data flow to specific downstream destinations, and dedicated Consent Filters and compliance docs reinforce this as a first-class capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that opt-outs are actually honored end-to-end across real destination partners, and detail on default vs opt-in enforcement per integration.
